## Top Picks for Discovery Packs (Priority Order)

### 1. Watches and Wonders Geneva — Public Days
**Dates:** April 18–20, 2026 (full salon: April 14–20)
**Location:** Palexpo, Geneva + citywide activations
**Why it fits:** The world's most prestigious watchmaking salon — 66 luxury maisons (Rolex, Patek Philippe, Cartier, A. Lange & Söhne). Public days with guided tours, panels, and full floor access. Ultra-luxury demographic, globally known.
**Price range:** CHF 45–90/day; Premium Package CHF 550
**Suggested pack angle:** "Geneva Horology Weekend" — watches by day, private chef dinner by night
**Source:** https://www.watchesandwonders.com/en/geneva-2026/event

---

### 2. Zermatt Unplugged — Acoustic Music Festival
**Dates:** April 7–11, 2026
**Location:** 14 intimate venues across Zermatt, at the foot of the Matterhorn
**Why it fits:** 30,000 visitors, lineup includes Placebo, Tom Odell, Emeli Sandé, Kings of Convenience, Herbert Grönemeyer — all acoustic. Spring skiing + music festival combo is the ideal premium travel package.
**Price range:** Day tickets ~CHF 60–120; Festival Pass ~CHF 200–300
**Suggested pack angle:** "Sound & Snow — Zermatt Unplugged" — last powder days + acoustic nights
**Source:** https://zermatt-unplugged.ch/en/

---

### 3. Sechseläuten — Zurich Spring Guild Parade
**Dates:** April 17–20, 2026 (Böögg burning: Monday April 20 at 6pm)
**Location:** Sechseläutenplatz and Bahnhofstrasse, Zurich
**Why it fits:** Zurich's oldest spring tradition — historic guilds parade in full costume through the Altstadt with brass bands and horses, ending with dramatic snowman bonfire. Genuine civic ritual, not a tourist event. Perfect "only-in-Zurich" insider cultural moment.
**Price range:** Free to attend; pair with Baur au Lac or The Dolder Grand dinner
**Suggested pack angle:** "Old Zurich Spring" — guild parade + Altstadt dinner + private city tour
**Source:** https://www.zuerich.com/en/events-nightlife/typical-events/sechselauten

---

### 4. YETI Xtreme Verbier — Freeride World Tour Grand Finale
**Dates:** March 27–29, 2026 (weather window, may extend)
**Location:** Bec des Rosses, Verbier (3,223m)
**Why it fits:** Most prestigious freeride competition in the world. Spectators watch from the mountain as the world's best drop 600m of 43-degree terrain. Free to watch — rare alpine spectacle with incredible proximity to elite athletes.
**Price range:** Free to spectate; Verbier hotel stays CHF 400–800/night
**Suggested pack angle:** "Verbier Freeride Final" — mountain spectating + heli-picnic + spa recovery
**Source:** https://www.freerideworldtour.com/events/2026-yeti-xtreme-verbier/

---

### 5. Lucerne Festival Spring
**Dates:** March 27–29, 2026
**Location:** KKL Lucerne (Jean Nouvel, lakeside)
**Why it fits:** World-class orchestral music in one of Europe's most architecturally stunning concert halls. Lucerne Festival Orchestra under Riccardo Chailly performs Beethoven; final Swiss performance of the Hagen Quartet (50-year career closing).
**Price range:** CHF 15–200+
**Suggested pack angle:** "Lucerne Classical Weekend" — concert + Lake Lucerne boat tour + fondue dinner
**Source:** https://www.lucernefestival.ch/en/spring-2026

### 6. Patrouille des Glaciers — Zermatt to Verbier
**Dates:** April 13–19, 2026
**Location:** Zermatt → Arolla → Verbier (57km, 4,400m elevation gain)
**Notes:** Legendary Swiss Army ski mountaineering race, run every 2 years. 5,500 participants. Spectator access in Verbier. Unique "once every two years" angle.
